itemListElement.name: Google Meet AI Note Taker Options for Hindi and Hinglish Teams in India in 2026

mainEntity.name: Does Google Meet have a free AI note taker?

acceptedAnswer.text: Take notes for me needs an eligible Workspace edition or Google AI plan, so it is not free on personal Gmail accounts. One detail catches teams out: admins can turn it on automatically for some meetings, so check your calendar invites before assuming nothing is listening.

mainEntity.name: Does Google Meet's AI note taker support Hindi?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Google lists 8 supported languages, and Hindi is not among them. The language is set per meeting rather than per participant, so one Hindi speaker in an English meeting still gets transcribed into the meeting language. Lynkk's Hinglish setting handles mid-sentence switching instead.

mainEntity.name: How do I add an AI note taker to Google Meet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Turn on Take notes for me inside the meeting, connect a bot-based tool to your calendar, or install a Chrome extension such as Lynkk's or Tactiq. Worth knowing: if your admin requires consent, every participant sees a prompt and must click Start, Join or Continue before capture begins.

mainEntity.name: What is the best Google Meet AI note taker for India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lynkk suits Indian teams because it supports Hindi, has a Hinglish setting and offers an India data region. Read AI lists Hindi reports too. Test on a real 20-minute Hinglish meeting, and check how each tool spells Indian names and handles lakh and crore figures.

mainEntity.name: Is it legal to use an AI note taker in Google Meet in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using an AI note taker is generally allowed when participants know the meeting is being recorded or transcribed. Under the DPDP Act, be clear about how personal data is processed and stored. Note that Google shares its notes with everyone on the invite, not only the people who attended.

mainEntity.name: Can a Google Meet AI note taker work without a bot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Google's own Take notes for me works without a bot, and Lynkk's Chrome extension and Tactiq capture Meet calls without a bot joining.
